name: In Real Life... or Death!
source:
They came together as friends from the same MMORPG guild. But their long-awaited real-life meeting takes a dark turn when a series of mysterious accidents begin.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
他们是来自同一个MMORPG公会的朋友。但当一系列神秘事故开始时，他们期待已久的现实生活中的会面发生了黑暗的转变。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
